title: Flash rust
text: Flash rust. I like everything about this pot except for the flash rust that comes out of the handles after washing that was disappointing. After a few uses the enamel faded and it scratches very easily. It works for what it is. Just do not expect the heavy duty quality of what was made years ago because this is not even close.
